description: This file defines various configuration schemas for IRC channels and accounts, including validation rules, using the Zod schema validation library. It also imports functions and schemas from external modules to build and extend configurations specific to IRC.

methods.name: IrcGroupSchema
methods.description: Schema for IRC group configuration, including optional settings for mention requirement, tools, skills, and permissions.

methods.name: IrcNickServSchema
methods.description: Schema for IRC NickServ authentication settings, with validation for registration email if registration is enabled.

methods.name: IrcAccountSchemaBase
methods.description: Base schema for IRC account configurations, including connection details, identity, policies, channels, and other settings.

methods.name: IrcAccountSchema
methods.description: Extended IRC account schema with additional validation for 'allowFrom' field based on 'dmPolicy'.

methods.name: IrcConfigSchema
methods.description: Overall IRC configuration schema including multiple accounts and default account setting, with validation.

methods.name: IrcChannelConfigSchema
methods.description: Final schema for IRC channel configuration, built using 'buildChannelConfigSchema' with specific UI hints.
